title: Projection defect on a plane: |<p_S u, p_S w> - <u, w>| <= |p_S - p_T|^2 |u| |w| for u, w in T (Simon 4.5 (10)-(11))
statement:
For every m in N, all linear subspaces S, T of R^m = EuclideanSpace R (Fin m), with orthogonal projections p := S.starProjection and P := T.starProjection, and all u, w in T: |

- | <= hsNormSq(p - P) * (|u| |w|), where hsNormSq A = sum_{i in Fin m} |A e_i|^2 (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1) is the squared Hilbert-Schmidt norm and <.,.>, |.| are the Euclidean inner product and norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (S T : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)) (u w : Rn m), u ∈ T → w ∈ T → |inner ℝ (S.starProjection u) (S.starProjection w) - inner ℝ u w| ≤ hsNormSq (S.starProjection - T.starProjection) * (‖u‖ * ‖w‖)
